| legend.required-mark | `color.status.danger.text` | `#f73f35` | use |
| message.text | `color.status.danger.text` | `#f73f35` | use |

#### Purpose

One choice among two to roughly six visible options; fewer is a checkbox or
switch, more a select. It differs from a checkbox by the inner square
instead of ✓ and by arrow keys instead of separate tab stops.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | 16px square, 1px {color.border.control} on {color.surface.input}; text {color.text.default} | — |
| hover | box → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; a checked box → {color.action.primary.hover-bg} | cursor: pointer; hover-capable pointers only |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} ring at −2px around the box | the ring |
| checked | box fills {color.action.primary.bg}; 8px inner square in {color.action.primary.text}; border stays {color.border.control} | the inner square; `checked` |
| checked+focus-visible | the fill and a ring in {color.interaction.focus.ring-container} | inner square and ring |
| disabled | boxes {color.interaction.disabled.bg}, 1px {color.border.disabled}; inner square and text {color.text.disabled} | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |
| invalid | every box border 2px {color.status.danger.border}; message with the ✕ glyph | border width 1 → 2px; glyph; `aria-invalid` |
| required | `*` after the legend in {color.status.danger.text} plus visually hidden "required" | `required`; the mark |

Precedence: disabled > invalid > checked > hover; focus-visible is always
drawn.

#### Keyboard

Native and one tab stop. Arrows move focus and the check together, so a
radio group never navigates or sends a request on change; the value is read
on submit or through an explicit action.

#### Accessibility

The legend names the group and is read before each option. `aria-invalid` is
set on the inputs after submit. A group with no default checked radio has a
required mark or a "none" option, so the empty state is intentional. Text
meets 4.5:1; box edges, the inner square and rings 3:1.

#### Portability

Square, border, fill and one inner square; no pseudo-element. A host that
insists on a circular indicator records the deviation instead of replacing
the control with a custom widget.

#### Non-examples

Circular radios. Checked shown by border colour alone, without the inner
square. Submitting or navigating on change. No legend, or the legend as one
option's label. A tab stop per radio. A lone radio. Disabling by opacity. A
div with `role="radiogroup"` built from spans.

### Switch (`switch`)

An on/off control that takes effect immediately; a button with role switch and aria-checked, drawn as a square-cornered track with a square thumb that fills with the primary colour when on. Family: forms-basic. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, checked, checked+focus-visible, disabled, checked+disabled.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| track.bg | `color.surface.input` | `#000000` | use |
| track.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| track.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| track.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| track.bg-checked | `color.action.primary.bg` | `#7d1310` | use |
| track.bg-checked-hover | `color.action.primary.hover-bg` | `#911410` | use |
| track.ring-checked | `color.interaction.focus.ring-container` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| track.bg-disabled | `color.interaction.disabled.bg` | `#160b0b` | use |
| track.border-disabled | `color.border.disabled` | `#7d1310` | use |
| thumb.bg | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| thumb.bg-checked | `color.action.primary.text` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| thumb.bg-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| name.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| state.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| name.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |

#### Purpose

A setting that applies the moment it is toggled: notifications, wrap lines,
follow system theme. A choice applied on submit is a checkbox. The switch is
a button because it acts; it is not a form field.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; the thumb sits at the start when off and at
the end when on.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | track 1px {color.border.control} on {color.surface.input}; thumb {color.text.default} at the start | thumb position |
| hover | off track → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; on track → {color.action.primary.hover-bg} | cursor: pointer; hover-capable pointers only |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px on the track | the ring |
| checked | track fills {color.action.primary.bg}; thumb {color.action.primary.text} at the end; border stays {color.border.control}; the word reads "On" | `aria-checked="true"`; thumb position; the word |
| checked+focus-visible | the fill and a {color.interaction.focus.ring-container} ring on the track | position and ring |
| disabled | track {color.interaction.disabled.bg}, 1px {color.border.disabled}; thumb and name {color.text.disabled} | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |
| checked+disabled | as disabled, thumb at the end | `disabled`; `aria-checked="true"`; thumb position |

The thumb moves without animation by default; a host may transition
`transform` for at most 120ms under `prefers-reduced-motion:
no-preference`. Precedence: disabled > checked > hover; focus-visible is
always drawn.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table; no arrow keys between switches. Toggling never moves
focus.

#### Accessibility

On a native button only `aria-checked` is scripted. The name states what is
on ("Wrap long lines"), never the current value. Thumb position and, with
labels, the word also carry the state. The thumb and track edge meet 3:1,
the ring 3:1 off and on.

#### Portability

The thumb position is layout, not a transform, so it survives hosts with no
animation. Hosts with a native switch use it, square it, and map the two
fills.

#### Non-examples

A pill track or round thumb. A switch that applies on submit. A checkbox
input styled as a switch. Colour as the only on/off difference. A green on
colour. "On" as the name. Disabling by opacity. A slide longer than 120ms or
one under reduced motion.

### Fieldset (`fieldset`)

The native fieldset that groups related fields under a legend inside a 1px divider border; disabling it disables everything inside. Family: forms-basic. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, disabled.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.border | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| legend.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| body.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| legend.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| field.bg | `color.surface.input` | `#000000` | use |
| field.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| field.bg-disabled | `color.interaction.disabled.bg` | `#160b0b` | use |
| field.border-disabled | `color.border.disabled` | `#7d1310` | use |
| field.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| help.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |

#### Purpose

Groups fields that belong together: an address, a set of credentials, the
options of one feature. Checkbox and radio groups use their own components,
which are fieldsets too.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy. The border is a decorative section rule; the
legend and the spacing carry the grouping.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | 1px {color.border.divider} border; legend {color.text.bright}; fields as their own components | the border and the legend |
| disabled | legend and labels {color.text.disabled}; each control takes its own disabled treatment ({color.interaction.disabled.bg}, {color.border.disabled}); border unchanged | `disabled` on the fieldset; cursor: not-allowed on the controls |

#### Keyboard

None of its own; a disabled group's controls leave the tab order natively.

#### Accessibility

The legend names the group and is announced before its first field; it says
what the group is, not what to do. Groups nest at most two levels. Because
disabling hides controls from keyboard users, a disabled group states why in
text before it or keeps its controls enabled. Legend, labels and help meet
4.5:1.

#### Portability

Hosts without a legend-in-border draw the heading above the box and record
it. Disabled propagation is native on the web, GTK and Qt; a host without it
disables each control.

#### Non-examples

No legend, or a visually hidden one. A card instead of a fieldset for form
controls. Rounded corners. A 2px or `border.control` border, which reads as a
control. A legend in accent red. Disabling only the legend. Three levels of
nesting.

### Number field (`number-field`)

The text-field box around a native number input with right-aligned tabular digits, an optional unit affix and two square stepper buttons that replace the host spinner. Family: forms-basic. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, invalid, invalid+focus-visible, disabled, read-only.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.input` | `#000000` | use |
| root.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| root.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| root.border-focus | `color.border.active` | `#e53935` | use |
| root.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| root.ring-invalid | `color.interaction.focus.ring-container` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| root.border-invalid | `color.status.danger.border` | `#e53935` | use |
| root.border-disabled | `color.border.disabled` | `#7d1310` | use |
| root.bg-disabled | `color.interaction.disabled.bg` | `#160b0b` | use |
| root.border-readonly | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| root.bg-readonly | `color.surface.canvas` | `#000000` | use |
| input.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| input.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| input.caret | `color.code.caret` | `#e99499` | use |
| unit.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| unit.border | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| action.text | `color.action.tertiary.text` | `#e99499` | use |
| action.bg-hover | `color.action.tertiary.hover-bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| action.border | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| label.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| help.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| message.text | `color.status.danger.text` | `#f73f35` | use |

#### Purpose

Entering a bounded number: a gap in pixels, a timeout, a count. The host
spinner, tiny and inconsistent, gives way to two square buttons that are
real tab stops. Free-form numeric text (a version, an identifier) is a
`text-field` with `inputmode`.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; each stepper button is at least 24px wide.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | 1px {color.border.control} on {color.surface.input}; digits {color.text.default}; unit {color.text.muted}; stepper glyphs {color.action.tertiary.text} | — |
| hover | background → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; a hovered stepper button → {color.action.tertiary.hover-bg} | cursor: text on the input, pointer on the buttons |
| focus-visible | border → {color.border.active}; 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px on the box or the focused stepper button | the ring |
| invalid | 2px {color.status.danger.border}; message with the ✕ glyph | border 1 → 2px; glyph; `aria-invalid` |
| invalid+focus-visible | the 2px danger border and the ring in {color.interaction.focus.ring-container} at −4px | double boundary |
| disabled | text, unit and glyphs {color.text.disabled}; border {color.border.disabled}; background {color.interaction.disabled.bg}; buttons disabled | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |
| read-only | no box: 1px dotted {color.border.divider} bottom edge on {color.surface.canvas}; stepper hidden | `readonly`; dotted edge; no buttons |

Precedence: disabled > invalid > hover; focus-visible is always drawn.

#### Keyboard

A value outside the range may be typed; it is reported invalid on blur or
submit, never clamped silently.

#### Accessibility

A programmatic label is required. The `aria-hidden` unit is repeated in the
label or help ("Inner gap (px)"). Help states min, max and step before the
user types. `aria-invalid` only after interaction or submit. Text meets
4.5:1; borders 3:1.

#### Portability

The `text-field` box plus two buttons; the host spinner is hidden with the
engine's pseudo-elements and `appearance: textfield`. A host whose spin
buttons cannot be replaced styles them square in the same colours and
records it.

#### Non-examples

The host's default spinner. Round or overlapping stepper buttons. A value
clamped silently. Left-aligned digits. A unit typed into the value. A number
field for phone numbers, postcodes or identifiers. Invalid by colour alone.
Disabling by opacity.

Family: forms-basic. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, placeholder-shown, filled, loading, disabled, no-results.

| root.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| root.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| root.border-focus | `color.border.active` | `#e53935` | use |
| root.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| root.border-disabled | `color.border.disabled` | `#7d1310` | use |
| root.bg-disabled | `color.interaction.disabled.bg` | `#160b0b` | use |
| input.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| input.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| input.placeholder | `color.text.placeholder` | `#a3676b` | use |
| input.caret | `color.code.caret` | `#e99499` | use |
| icon.stroke | `color.icon.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| loading.glyph | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |

| label.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| help.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| status.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |

#### Purpose

Filtering a list or table, or searching a site. A search that suggests as you
type is the combobox.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy. The loading glyph takes the magnifier's slot,
so the box never changes size.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | 1px {color.border.control} on {color.surface.input}; magnifier {color.icon.default}; text {color.text.default} | the magnifier |
| hover | background → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; a hovered clear button → {color.action.tertiary.hover-bg} | cursor: text |
| focus-visible | border → {color.border.active}; 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} ring at −2px; the hint hides | the ring |
| placeholder-shown | placeholder in {color.text.placeholder}, italic; no clear button | italic; clear button absent |
| filled | as default with a value; clear button present | the clear button |
| loading | static `⋯` in {color.text.muted} replaces the magnifier; input stays editable | glyph; `aria-busy` |
| disabled | text and icon {color.text.disabled}, border {color.border.disabled}, background {color.interaction.disabled.bg}; no clear button | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |
| no-results | status line "No results for …" in {color.text.muted} below the help; box unchanged | the status text; `role="status"` |

Precedence: disabled > loading > hover; focus-visible is always drawn. A
search field is never invalid; an empty result is a status, not an error.

#### Keyboard

Escape-to-clear is native for `type="search"` in most engines and scripted
where it is not. The host never captures the shortcut while another field has
focus.

#### Accessibility

A programmatic label is required even when hidden. The status line announces
"No results" once, after the query settles, and the result count there too
("12 results"). The clear button is named "Clear <label>". Text meets 4.5:1;
the magnifier, borders and rings 3:1.

#### Portability

Hosts that cannot draw the hint omit it and keep the shortcut in the tooltip.

#### Non-examples

Rounded or pill-shaped boxes. A magnifier button that submits. A spinner while
loading. Results announced on every keystroke. "No results" in red or with
the ✕ glyph. An always-visible clear button. No label. Disabling by opacity.

#### Purpose

A bounded numeric value on a native slider with a visible output.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | named content on the default surface | native text and structure |
| focus-visible | dashed focus ring | native focus position |
| disabled | disabled foreground, background and border at full opacity | native disabled state blocks activation |

Native, as in the key table.

#### Accessibility

The input keeps its accessible name and native value semantics; the output
never replaces the label. Units go in the label or help text. Focus alone
never changes the value.

Follows the shared component defaults in `spec/portability.md` (section

#### Non-examples

Unlabelled controls. Colour-only status. Drag-only operations. Hidden

## Advanced forms

Combobox, multiselect, date and time, file selection, repeaters, wizard, bounded form-builder specimen.

### Combobox (`combobox`)

#### Purpose

A text input completed from a list of suggestions, for large or open-ended
sets (fonts, hosts, tags); a closed set of a dozen values is `select`. The
demonstration renders the list open so every option state shows without a
script.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; help and validation message behave as in
`text-field`.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | 1px {color.border.control} on {color.surface.input}; list on {color.surface.raised}, 1px {color.border.overlay} | — |
| hover | box → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; hovered option → {color.interaction.hover.bg-strong} with {color.text.link-hover} | cursor: text on the box, default on the list |
| focus-visible | box border → {color.border.active}; 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px | the ring |
| open | list below the box; toggle glyph rotated 180° | `aria-expanded="true"`; toggle glyph |
| closed | no list; box unchanged | `aria-expanded="false"`; nothing below the box |
| selected | active option filled {color.interaction.selection.bg} with {color.interaction.selection.text}, 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} ring at −2px | `aria-selected="true"`; `aria-activedescendant`; the ring |
| invalid | 2px {color.status.danger.border}; message with ✕ | border 1 → 2px; glyph; `aria-invalid` |
| invalid+focus-visible | 2px danger border and {color.interaction.focus.ring-container} ring at −4px | double boundary |
| disabled | {color.text.disabled}, {color.border.disabled}, {color.interaction.disabled.bg}; list never opens | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |
| no-results | only the empty row, {color.text.muted} italic | `aria-disabled` row; italic; polite zero-match announcement |

Precedence when several apply: disabled > invalid > selected > hover;
focus-visible is always drawn on the box, and the selection ring on the
option.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table. Typing filters on every keystroke; the match count is
announced through a polite live region, not by re-reading the list.

#### Accessibility

The listbox is named (`aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` the field label);
options are `role="option"`, `aria-selected` on the active one only; groups
are `role="group"` labelled by their heading. The empty row is a disabled
option so the list is never empty. Text meets 4.5:1; list border and
selection ring 3:1.

#### Portability

Background, border and outline express everything; the toggle rotation is a
transform inside the motion budget. A toolkit with a native completion popup
uses it, mapping the option fill to the selection roles and the list border
to the popover frame. Without `aria-activedescendant`, real focus moves to the
option and the deviation is recorded.

#### Non-examples

A select restyled as a combobox. DOM focus moving into the list on Down. A
list floating with a shadow or rounded frame. The active option marked by text
colour alone. A no-results state that silently shows the full list. Opening
on hover. A list that slides or fades in for longer than 150 ms.

#### Purpose

Choose a date by typing or from a themed calendar; a range is two
separately labelled date controls. D-025: theme-owned web controls, not
browser popup styling.

#### Anatomy

A label, editor, calendar trigger, format hint and validation message. The
native date input stays the successful form control, owns value, defaults
and constraints, and is hidden only after enhancement.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | {color.text.default} on {color.surface.input}, 1px {color.border.control} | — |
| hover | background → {color.interaction.hover.bg} | hover-capable pointers only |
| focus-visible | border → {color.border.active}; the canonical focus ring | the ring |
| invalid | 2px {color.status.danger.border}; a linked message | border 1 → 2px; ✕ glyph; `aria-invalid` |
| invalid+focus-visible | the danger border and the ring in {color.interaction.focus.ring-container} at −4px | double boundary |
| disabled | {color.text.disabled} on {color.interaction.disabled.bg}, border {color.border.disabled}; editor and calendar actions unavailable | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |
| read-only | readable text on {color.surface.canvas}, no box, 1px dotted {color.border.divider} bottom edge; the calendar cannot open | `readonly`; dotted edge |

#### Keyboard

Arrows move by a day or a week. Tab leaves normally; the calendar is a
nonmodal popup.

#### Accessibility

The visible editor receives the original label, descriptions, required and
error state. Format hints are always available. Native min, max, step and
required stay authoritative. Invalid entry focuses the visible editor and
shows a theme-owned message. Calendar selection is a fill, focus a separate
ring. Disabled dates cannot be chosen. A range rejects an end before its
start. Form reset restores the native defaults. Automated evidence records
its browser, states and limits and is not a manual screen-reader acceptance.

#### Portability

The package and the complete copy distribution include the renderer; the
public control enhancement applies it to existing native markup. Without
JavaScript, and on non-web platforms, the control stays native.

#### Non-examples

An unthemed host popup presented as themed. A second named input
duplicating form values. Dropping native constraints, labels or reset.
Literal colours, rounded corners, or a selected fill with no distinct focus
boundary.

Choosing one or more files from the host. The native input keeps the host
chooser, its keyboard and its security model; the theme replaces only its
rendering.

Parts as listed in the anatomy; help and message sit below the root.

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | button: 1px {color.action.secondary.border} outline, text {color.action.secondary.text}; zone: 1px dashed {color.interaction.drop-target} | — |

| invalid | button border 2px {color.status.danger.border}; message with ✕; a failed row shows its own ✕ | border 1 → 2px; glyphs; `aria-invalid` |
| disabled | button text {color.text.disabled}, border {color.border.disabled}, fill {color.interaction.disabled.bg}; zone dashes {color.border.disabled}; no hover | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |

Precedence: disabled > loading > invalid > drop-target > hover;
focus-visible is always drawn.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table; closing the chooser returns focus to the input.
Dropping is pointer-only and never the sole way to add a file.

#### Accessibility

Hide the input with `sr-only`, never `display: none` or `visibility: hidden`,
so it keeps focus and the chooser. Both labels name it ("Attachments",
"Choose files"); `aria-describedby` lists help and message. The status and
list are announced through a polite live region after a choice; per-file
errors are in the row text. The drop zone has no role and no `tabindex`.
Text meets 4.5:1; borders 3:1.

#### Portability

The button is the secondary button of the actions family; the stripes are a
repeating gradient or a hatched brush. Toolkits without drag-and-drop omit
the zone and keep the button; without a translucent fill, composite the
marquee over the canvas and record the value.

#### Non-examples

`display: none` on the input and a button that clicks it by script. A drop
zone as the only way to add files. A rounded, dotted or pulsing zone. A
spinner, or animated stripes, while uploading. Errors shown by a red file
name alone. Disabling by opacity.

#### Purpose

A form too long for one screen, split into ordered steps validated one at a
time. Steps are not tabs: a future step is unreachable until the steps before
it pass.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; the panel heading reads "Step n of m".

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | steps in {color.text.default}; complete steps carry ✓ in {color.status.success.text} | the ✓ glyph; the numbers |
| hover | step → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; Next → {color.action.primary.hover-bg}; Back → {color.action.secondary.hover-bg} | cursor: pointer |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} ring at −2px; {color.interaction.focus.ring-container} on Next's fill | the ring |
| current | 2px {color.border.selected-indicator} under the step; name in {color.text.bright} | `aria-current="step"`; the indicator bar; the heading reads "Step n of m" |
| disabled | a future step in {color.text.disabled}; no hover | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed; skipped by Tab |
| invalid | marker becomes ✕ in {color.status.danger.text}; indicator {color.status.danger.border}; the panel shows the message | glyph; message text; `aria-invalid` on the failing fields |
| busy | Next shows the static ⋯ before its label and ignores activation; size unchanged | `aria-busy` on the wizard; the glyph; cursor: progress |

Precedence: disabled > busy > invalid > current > hover; focus-visible is
always drawn.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table. A failed Next moves focus to the first invalid field; a
successful one to the new panel heading. No arrow keys between steps: the
stepper is a list of buttons, not a tablist.

#### Accessibility

The wizard is a region named by `aria-label`; the `<ol>` announces count and
position. Complete steps append a visually hidden ", complete". Unreachable
steps are `disabled`, not `aria-disabled`, because they cannot be activated.
Validation failures are announced through the form's live region and the ✕
marker. Text meets 4.5:1; the indicator and rings 3:1; future step text is
exempt (house floor 3:1).

#### Portability

Text, a 2px bottom border and the button tones; markers are text glyphs, no
icon font. A toolkit without a native assistant draws the stepper as a row of
buttons and records any deviation in the indicator width.

#### Non-examples

Tabs restyled as steps. A progress bar instead of the stepper. Circles with
connecting lines that need a radius. Future steps that look enabled and
reject the click. A spinner on Next. Colour-only completion marks. Validation
that blocks Back. Animated slides between panels.

### Form builder (`form-builder`)

A bounded reference editor for five canonical field kinds, with keyboard ordering, local preview and explicit JSON definition import and export. Family: forms-advanced. Priority: L. Maturity: draft. States: default, empty, invalid, disabled.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| root.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| root.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| status.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |

#### Purpose

Build a bounded reference form in the
[interactive builder](https://j3w1.github.io/theme/builder/). D-021 remains
proposed; this draft promotes no tokens, roles, profiles or native ports.

#### Anatomy

Each field has a stable ID, label, help, required flag and, for select and
radio, stable option IDs and labels. Saving an edit validates the whole
proposed definition before replacing the current one.

The preview uses the canonical field renderer and validation model of the
validation-recovery composition. Changing a definition clears preview values
and errors; moving focus or typing a preview value never changes the
definition.

#### States

The empty state shows an explanation and an add action. An invalid import or edit
reports a corrective message and keeps the current definition. Move buttons
are disabled at the list boundaries. Default shows the ordered definition and
preview. The static specimen shows the definition; interactive execution
evidence is recorded separately.

#### Keyboard

No drag is required. Moving keeps focus on the moved field's controls;
removing focuses the next remaining field or the add control; import and
reset return to the add control. Preview submit focuses its error summary,
whose links target stable field control IDs.

#### Accessibility

Use the canonical label, help and error associations, required markers and
radio fieldset/legend semantics. Stable IDs survive JSON round trips and
reordering. Imported strings are text, never markup. Test presence claims no
manual screen-reader pass.

#### Portability

Definition schema version 1 pins theme name, version, default profile and
constituent component content digest. Limits: 64 KiB, 20 fields, 20 options
per choice field, 120-character labels, 400-character help, 2000-character
preview text. Unknown keys, duplicate IDs, unsupported kinds, invalid choices
and mismatched theme identity are rejected atomically. An old content
identity needs an explicit migration outside this tool.

Everything stays in memory; only Download definition creates a file, with the
schema and no entered values. Reset clears definition and preview. No
autosave, network submission, schema execution, arbitrary HTML/CSS/JavaScript
or imported validation expression.

#### Non-examples

A production backend, conditional logic engine, drag-only editor, arbitrary
code generator, persistent account form, or native application port.

| root.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| heading.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| secondary.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| control.bg | `color.surface.input` | `#000000` | use |
| control.focus | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| button.bg | `color.action.secondary.bg` | `rgb(0 0 0 / 0%)` | use |
| button.text | `color.action.secondary.text` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| button.border | `color.action.secondary.border` | `#a3676b` | use |
| button.bg-hover | `color.action.secondary.hover-bg` | `#630f0d` | use |
| button.bg-active | `color.action.secondary.pressed-bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| button.border-active | `color.border.active` | `#e53935` | use |
| button.focus | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| dependency.role-border-width-default | `border.width.default` | `1px` | use |
| dependency.role-color-border-disabled | `color.border.disabled` | `#7d1310` | use |
| dependency.role-color-interaction-disabled-bg | `color.interaction.disabled.bg` | `#160b0b` | use |
| dependency.role-color-text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| dependency.role-density-comfortable-control-height | `density.comfortable.control-height` | `32px` | use |
| dependency.role-density-compact-control-height | `density.compact.control-height` | `24px` | use |
| dependency.role-focus-offset | `focus.offset` | `-2px` | use |
| dependency.role-radius-none | `radius.none` | `0px` | use |
| dependency.role-space-12 | `space.12` | `12px` | use |
| dependency.role-space-24 | `space.24` | `24px` | use |
| dependency.role-space-8 | `space.8` | `8px` | use |

#### Purpose

A variable number of the same native field row in one form; the host owns
the fields, submission and persistence.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | named content on the default surface. Button controls are the secondary button (button.md); inputs keep the input look. | native text and structure |
| empty | a muted empty message | explicit text; Add stays |
| focus-visible | dashed focus ring | native focus position |
| disabled | disabled foreground, background and border at full opacity | native disabled state blocks activation |

#### Keyboard

As in the key table; nothing else is bound.

#### Accessibility

IDs and label and ARIA references are namespaced per row. Actions are named
and keep their boundary when disabled. Removing a focused row moves focus to
a surviving row or to Add; each explicit operation is announced.

#### Portability

Follows the shared component defaults in `spec/portability.md` (section
"Shared component defaults").

#### Non-examples

Unlabelled controls. Colour-only status. Drag-only operations. Hidden
required instructions. Stolen focus. An invented service success.

## Navigation

Tabs, breadcrumbs, pagination, sidebar, toolbar, menus, command palette, tree.

### Tabs (`tabs`)

A tablist of buttons that switches between panels in place; the selected tab carries a 2px indicator bar and bright text, never a fill. Family: navigation. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, selected, selected+focus-visible, selected+container-inactive, disabled.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| list.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| list.border | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| tab.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| tab.text-selected | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| tab.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| tab.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| tab.bg-pressed | `color.interaction.pressed.bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| tab.indicator | `color.border.selected-indicator` | `#e53935` | use |
| tab.indicator-inactive | `color.border.selected-indicator-inactive` | `#9e231f` | use |
| tab.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| panel.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| panel.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |

#### Purpose

Navigation between peer panels within one view. Between views use
sidebar-nav; for exclusive options in a form use radio-group or
segmented-control.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy. The indicator sits on the rule; tabs carry no
fill and no box, and the bar is the only ornament.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | text {color.text.default}; transparent 2px bottom edge | — |
| hover | background → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; text unchanged | cursor: pointer |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} ring at −2px | the ring |
| selected | text {color.text.bright}; 2px {color.border.selected-indicator} bar | `aria-selected="true"`; the bar; tabindex 0 |
| selected+focus-visible | bar and ring together | both visible |
| selected+container-inactive | bar → {color.border.selected-indicator-inactive}; text stays bright | lightness drop of the bar; the container's own inactive state |
| disabled | text {color.text.disabled}; no hover; bar hidden unless selected | `disabled` or `aria-disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |

Precedence: disabled > selected > hover; focus-visible is always drawn.
{color.interaction.pressed.bg} shows only for the duration of a press.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table. Automatic activation is the default because panels are
cheap; use manual activation when a panel is expensive to render. The panel is
a tab stop only when it has no focusable content.

#### Accessibility

The tablist carries `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. A vertical tablist
sets `aria-orientation="vertical"` and swaps the arrow keys. Text meets
4.5:1; the indicator and ring 3:1. Each tab is at least 24×24 CSS pixels in
`compact`, with 4px between neighbours. The indicator is never the only
signal: `aria-selected` and the bright text travel with it.

#### Portability

A toolkit that cannot draw a partial bottom border draws a 2px rule across
the full tab width. Hosts with their own tab strip (browsers, editors) keep
their keyboard model and take only the colours and the 2px bar.

#### Non-examples

Pill or filled tabs. A selected tab in the selection fill. Rounded tabs or
bar. A strip that wraps to two lines. A selected tab that changes only its
text colour. A glow instead of the dashed ring. Every tab in the tab order.
Disabling by opacity.

### Breadcrumbs (`breadcrumbs`)

The path from the root to the current page as an ordered list of links separated by slashes; the last item is the current page and not a link. Family: navigation. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, current, truncated.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| link.text | `color.text.link` | `#f73f35` | use |
| link.underline | `color.text.link-underline` | `#dc282e` | use |
| link.text-hover | `color.text.link-hover` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| link.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| link.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| current.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| separator.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| ellipsis.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| ellipsis.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |

#### Purpose

Where the current page sits in a hierarchy, with a jump to any ancestor.
Secondary navigation: never a replacement for the sidebar or page title, and
omitted on the root page.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; the separator follows every item but the last.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | links {color.text.link}, 1px underline; separators {color.text.muted}; current {color.text.bright} | underline on links; none on the current page |
| hover | link → {color.interaction.hover.bg}, text {color.text.link-hover} | underline 1px → 2px; cursor |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px around the link | the ring |
| current | {color.text.bright}; no underline; no hover | `aria-current="page"`; no underline |
| truncated | middle levels replaced by an `…` button in {color.text.default} | `aria-expanded="false"`; its label counts the hidden levels |

#### Keyboard

As in the key table. The ellipsis button discloses the hidden levels in place
on Enter or Space; focus stays on it, so the revealed links are the next Tab
stops.

#### Accessibility

The `nav` label "Breadcrumb" is translated. The `aria-hidden` separator keeps
"slash" unspoken; the list gives the count. `aria-current="page"` marks the
last item, link or not. Hidden levels stay in the DOM (`hidden` until
disclosed) so find-in-page reaches them. Text meets 4.5:1; underline and ring
3:1. Each link is at least 24 CSS pixels tall through line box and padding.

#### Portability

Plain inline links and text; the separator needs only an inline-start margin
that flips in RTL. Without an underline, a toolkit draws the link in the link
colour and records the deviation. The ellipsis is optional; without it the
full trail shows and wraps.

#### Non-examples

Chevrons, arrows or bullets as separators. A trail ending with the site name
instead of the current page. The current page as an underlined link.
`text-overflow` truncation that hides unreachable levels. A horizontally
scrolling trail. Uppercase or letter-spaced items. Separators read aloud.

### Pagination (`pagination`)

Page links for a long result set; the current page takes the selection fill and aria-current, and the compact form reads "3 of 12" between previous and next. Family: navigation. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, current, disabled.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| link.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| link.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| link.bg-pressed | `color.interaction.pressed.bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| link.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| link.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| current.bg | `color.interaction.selection.bg` | `#531310` | use |
| current.text | `color.text.on-selection` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| current.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| gap.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| status.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| status.emphasis | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |

#### Purpose

Moves through a paged result set of known size. Feeds use a "load more"
button or infinite scroll; jumping to an arbitrary offset is a range field.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; page links have no border.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | {color.text.default}; no fill, no border | — |
| hover | background → {color.interaction.hover.bg} | cursor: pointer |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px, including the current page | the ring |
| current | fill {color.interaction.selection.bg}, text {color.text.on-selection}; no hover | `aria-current="page"` |
| disabled | {color.text.disabled}; no fill, no hover | `aria-disabled="true"`; no `href`; cursor: not-allowed |

A link shows {color.interaction.pressed.bg} only while pressed.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table. The current page stays a link to itself so a keyboard
user can reload it.

#### Accessibility

A second pagination on the same page gets a distinct label. Previous and next
carry a visible word, not just a glyph; `aria-label` gives the target page
when known ("Previous page, 2"). The list count tells a screen reader how many
links follow. Text meets 4.5:1 and the ring 3:1; disabled ends are exempt
(house floor 3:1). Targets are at least 24×24 CSS pixels in `compact`.

#### Portability

Links with a background and an outline; nothing else. A host that cannot
remove `href` from a disabled link uses a disabled button for the ends and
records it. The compact variant is plain text and two links.

#### Non-examples

Rounded or circular page buttons. A border around every page link. The
current page marked by colour or bold alone, without `aria-current`.
Glyph-only previous and next. A disabled end with an `href`. Hiding the last
page number. A horizontally scrolling row.

### Sidebar navigation (`sidebar-nav`)

A vertical list of section links with optional nested groups; the current section carries a 2px inline-start indicator and bright text, and the rail collapses to icons. Family: navigation. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, current, selected, selected+container-inactive, expanded, collapsed.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| root.border | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| link.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| link.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| link.bg-pressed | `color.interaction.pressed.bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| link.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| link.indicator | `color.border.selected-indicator` | `#e53935` | use |
| link.indicator-inactive | `color.border.selected-indicator-inactive` | `#9e231f` | use |
| current.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| selected.bg | `color.interaction.selection.bg` | `#531310` | use |
| selected.text | `color.interaction.selection.text` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| selected.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| selected.inactive-bg | `color.interaction.selection.inactive-bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| selected.inactive-text | `color.interaction.selection.inactive-text` | `#e99499` | use |
| icon.stroke | `color.icon.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| group.chevron | `color.icon.decorative` | `#a3676b` | use |

#### Purpose

Moves between the sections of an application: the primary navigation of a
settings panel, admin area or documentation site. Tabs switch views inside
one section; a tree browses data, not sections.

#### Anatomy

A `nav` on {color.surface.default} with a 1px {color.border.divider}
inline-end edge; otherwise parts as listed in the anatomy.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | text {color.text.default}; no fill; transparent inline-start edge | — |
| hover | → {color.interaction.hover.bg} | cursor: pointer |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px | the ring |
| current | 2px {color.border.selected-indicator} inline-start bar; text {color.text.bright} | `aria-current="page"`; the bar |
| selected | {color.interaction.selection.bg} with {color.interaction.selection.text}; 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px when focused | `aria-selected` on a listbox-style rail; the on-fill text |
| selected+container-inactive | {color.interaction.selection.inactive-bg} with {color.interaction.selection.inactive-text}; no ring | lightness drop between the two fills |
| expanded | chevron rotated 90°; sublist shown | `aria-expanded="true"`; the children are present |
| collapsed | labels visually hidden; icons centred; current bar and fills unchanged | labels remain for assistive technology and as tooltips |

`current` is where the user is; `selected` is what the user chose in a rail
that drives a detail pane. A rail is one or the other, never both.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table; toggling a group leaves focus on its button. No arrow
keys: the rail is a list of links, not a tree.

#### Accessibility

`aria-label` on the `nav` distinguishes the landmark. A rail that drives a
detail pane is a listbox with `aria-selected`, not links. A closed sublist is
`hidden`, so its links leave the tab order. Collapsed labels are clipped, not
`display: none`, so names survive; icon-only links also get a `title`. Text
meets 4.5:1; the indicator 3:1. Rows are at least 24 CSS pixels tall in
`compact`.

#### Portability

The chevron is an SVG. Toolkits without logical borders draw the bar on the
left in LTR and on the right in RTL explicitly. Hosts that cannot hide labels while keeping their
names show the full rail.

#### Non-examples

A filled or rounded current item. The indicator on the inline-end edge. A
current item marked by bold alone. Labels removed from the DOM when
collapsed. Hidden children left in the tab order. A rail that scrolls
horizontally. Icon-only links without an accessible name. Hover that changes
the text colour.

### Toolbar (`toolbar`)

A row of related controls under one tab stop with arrow-key movement; ghost buttons, a vertical separator, and a "more" button when the row overflows. Family: navigation. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, disabled, toggled.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.chrome` | `#090707` | use |
| root.border | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| button.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| button.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| button.bg-pressed | `color.interaction.pressed.bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| button.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| button.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| toggled.bg | `color.interaction.pressed.bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| toggled.border | `color.border.active` | `#e53935` | use |
| toggled.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| separator.color | `color.border.default` | `#531310` | use |
| more.chevron | `color.icon.decorative` | `#a3676b` | use |

#### Purpose

Groups a view's frequent actions on the content beneath it into one row that
costs one tab stop. Navigation between views belongs in tabs or the sidebar;
mutually exclusive choices in a segmented control or radio group.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | text {color.text.default}; no fill; transparent border | — |
| hover | background → {color.interaction.hover.bg} | cursor: pointer |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} ring at −2px | the ring |
| disabled | text {color.text.disabled}; no fill; no hover | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed; skipped by the arrow keys |
| toggled | fill {color.interaction.pressed.bg}; 1px {color.border.active} border; text {color.text.bright} | `aria-pressed="true"`; the border |

A press shows {color.interaction.pressed.bg} only while it lasts; a toggled
button keeps it.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table. The roving stop is the last focused control, initially
the first enabled one.

#### Accessibility

A page with several toolbars names each distinctly. A toggle button's label
does not change with its state. Icon-only buttons carry `aria-label` and a
tooltip. Text meets 4.5:1, the toggled border and the ring 3:1. Every control
is at least 24×24 CSS pixels with 4px between neighbours in `compact`.

#### Portability

Toolkits with a native toolbar keep their own keyboard model and take the
colours. The overflow menu is the menu component; hosts without one wrap the
row and record the deviation.

#### Non-examples

Buttons bordered at rest. A filled primary button in the toolbar. Rounded
buttons or a pill-shaped toolbar. Every button in the tab order when script
is available. A toggled state by colour alone without `aria-pressed`. A
toolbar wrapping to two lines. A focusable separator. Disabling by opacity.

### Menu (`menu`)

A menu button that opens a list of actions on the raised surface inside a 1px overlay border; the active item is the selection fill and check items show a glyph. Family: navigation. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, open, closed, disabled, checked, selected.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| button.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| button.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| button.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| button.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| button.bg-open | `color.interaction.pressed.bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| button.border-open | `color.border.active` | `#e53935` | use |
| button.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| surface.bg | `color.surface.raised` | `#160b0b` | use |
| surface.border | `color.border.overlay` | `#e53935` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| item.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| item.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg-strong` | `#630f0d` | use |
| item.text-hover | `color.text.link-hover` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| item.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| active.bg | `color.interaction.selection.bg` | `#531310` | use |
| active.text | `color.interaction.selection.text` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| active.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| check.glyph | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| shortcut.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| separator.color | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| chevron.color | `color.icon.decorative` | `#a3676b` | use |

#### Purpose

A short list of commands behind one button. Choosing a value is `select` or
`combobox`; moving between views is tabs or the sidebar. Running an action
closes the menu; a check item toggles and leaves it open.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy. The active item, reached by pointer or arrow
key, takes the selection fill.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | button at rest; list on {color.surface.raised} in the {color.border.overlay} frame | — |
| hover | item → {color.interaction.hover.bg-strong}, text {color.text.link-hover} | cursor: pointer |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px on the button and the active item | the ring |
| open | button {color.interaction.pressed.bg} with 1px {color.border.active}; list shown | `aria-expanded="true"`; list present |
| closed | button at rest; list hidden | `aria-expanded="false"`; list absent from the tree |
| disabled | item text {color.text.disabled}; no hover; still reachable by arrow keys when `aria-disabled` | `aria-disabled="true"`; cursor: not-allowed |
| checked | ✓ in {color.text.bright} in the gutter | `aria-checked="true"`; the glyph |
| selected | active item filled {color.interaction.selection.bg} with {color.interaction.selection.text} | focus on the item; `aria-activedescendant` where used |

Precedence: disabled > selected > hover; focus-visible is always drawn.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table; focus never rests on a separator.

#### Accessibility

The list is `aria-labelledby` the button. Disabled items use `aria-disabled`
so they stay reachable and announced. Shortcut hints are text, not
`aria-keyshortcuts` alone. Text meets 4.5:1; frame and ring 3:1. Items are at
least 24 CSS pixels tall in `compact`.

#### Portability

A framed box of rows: the active row a fill, the frame a border, the ring an
outline. Native menus keep their keyboard model and take the surface, frame
and fill colours. A host that cannot draw the frame in the overlay colour
uses the strong border colour and records the deviation.

#### Non-examples

A shadow under the menu. Rounded menu or items. An active item marked by text
colour alone. A hover fill unlike every other menu in the product. Icons in a
plain menuitem's check gutter. A menu that stays open after an action. Links
styled as menu items without `role="menuitem"`. Disabling by opacity.

### Skip link (`skip-link`)

The first tab stop of a page, hidden until it receives keyboard focus, that jumps past the chrome to the main content. Family: navigation. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, focus-visible.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.raised` | `#160b0b` | use |
| root.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| root.border | `color.border.overlay` | `#e53935` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| root.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |

#### Purpose

Lets a keyboard user bypass the header, navigation and toolbars in one press,
satisfying WCAG 2.4.1. A page with nothing before `main` does not need one.

#### Anatomy

A small raised card: {color.surface.raised}, 1px {color.border.overlay}, text
{color.text.bright}.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | off-screen; nothing painted | still in the tab order and the accessibility tree |
| focus-visible | appears in the top corner; 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} ring at −2px | the link appears; the ring |

No hover state: a pointer cannot reach the hidden link, and once visible it
behaves as a link.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table; after Enter the next Tab continues inside the content.

#### Accessibility

The link text names the destination ("Skip to content"), translated.
`aria-hidden` defeats it as surely as `display: none` or `visibility: hidden`.
The reveal is an instant position change, so reduced motion needs no special
case. Text meets 4.5:1; frame and ring 3:1. The visible target is at least 24
CSS pixels tall.

#### Portability

Web-only. Frameworks that render their own header keep this exact markup first
in the body; a host stylesheet that removes outlines must restore the ring
here. The reference site uses this component for its own skip link.

#### Non-examples

Always visible. Hidden with `display: none` or `visibility: hidden`. Not the
first tab stop. Pointing at an element without `tabindex="-1"`, so focus does
not move. Sliding in from the side and causing horizontal scroll while hidden.
A rounded pill. Rendered without the frame on the canvas.

## Information display

Cards, lists, badges, chips, avatars, descriptions, tables, timelines, simple charts.

### Card (`card`)

A bordered panel that groups a title, body and metadata; a link card makes the whole panel one link, a selectable card is an option with the selection fill. Family: display. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, selected, selected+focus-visible.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| root.border | `color.border.default` | `#531310` | use |
| root.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| root.border-hover | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| root.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring-container` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| title.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| body.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| meta.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| selected.bg | `color.interaction.selection.bg` | `#531310` | use |
| selected.text | `color.interaction.selection.text` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| selected.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |

#### Purpose

Groups a title, a line or two and a metadata line so they read as one
thing. Static by default; a link when the whole unit leads somewhere, an
option when the user picks among units. Not a dialog, a form or a table row.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy. Padding 12px in `comfortable`, 8px in
`compact`.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | 1px {color.border.default} on {color.surface.default} | — |
| hover | link and selectable cards only: background → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; border → {color.border.control} | cursor: pointer; the border lightens from decorative to control |
| focus-visible | container ring 2px solid {color.interaction.focus.ring-container} at −3px | the ring |
| selected | fill {color.interaction.selection.bg}, {color.interaction.selection.text} on every line | `aria-selected="true"`; the on-fill text |
| selected+focus-visible | the fill and 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px | both visible at once |

A static card has no hover and no focus, and is not in the tab order.

#### Keyboard

A link card may hold no controls (a link cannot contain a button). A static
card contributes only the controls it contains to the tab order.

#### Accessibility

A static card is an `article` with a heading when it stands alone, or a
`section` inside a list. A link card names itself from its content, title
first. A selectable group's listbox carries `aria-label`. On the selection
fill every line takes the on-fill text, because muted text would fall below
4.5:1. Text meets 4.5:1; the ring 3:1 on the card and on the fill.

#### Portability

A bordered box with a background and an outline. Toolkits that shadow their
frames remove it. A host without outlines draws a 2px inner border for the container ring,
1px for the selected card, and records it.

#### Non-examples

A shadow or elevation. Rounded corners. A hover lift or scale. A hover fill
on a static card. An invisible overlay as the only clickable part. A link
card containing buttons. A selected card shown by border colour alone,
without the fill and `aria-selected`. Muted metadata left on the selection
fill.

### List (`list`)

A selectable list of rows (an APG listbox) in single or multiple selection; the selected row is the selection fill with a check glyph and an optional metadata column. Family: display. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, selected, selected+focus-visible, selected+container-inactive, disabled.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| root.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| row.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| row.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| row.divider | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| row.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| row.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| selected.bg | `color.interaction.selection.bg` | `#531310` | use |
| selected.text | `color.interaction.selection.text` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| selected.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| selected.inactive-bg | `color.interaction.selection.inactive-bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| selected.inactive-text | `color.interaction.selection.inactive-text` | `#e99499` | use |
| check.glyph | `color.interaction.selection.text` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| meta.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |

#### Purpose

Choose one or several rows from a short, visible set. It holds a selection
and never navigates: rows that lead somewhere are `sidebar-nav`, rows with
columns a `table`, a long set that needs filtering a `combobox`.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; on a selected row every part, metadata and
✓ included, takes {color.interaction.selection.text}.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | text {color.text.default}; no fill; check gutter empty | — |
| hover | background → {color.interaction.hover.bg} | cursor: pointer |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px on the option | the ring |
| selected | fill {color.interaction.selection.bg}; text and glyph {color.interaction.selection.text} | `aria-selected="true"`; the ✓ glyph |
| selected+focus-visible | the fill and 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px | both visible at once |
| selected+container-inactive | fill {color.interaction.selection.inactive-bg} with {color.interaction.selection.inactive-text}; no ring | lightness drop between the two fills; the glyph stays |
| disabled | text {color.text.disabled}; no fill; no hover; still reachable by arrow keys | `aria-disabled="true"`; cursor: not-allowed |

Precedence: disabled > selected > hover; focus-visible is always drawn.

#### Keyboard

The list costs one tab stop (`tabindex="0"` on the selected or first
option, `-1` on the rest). Disabled options are reached and announced, never
skipped.

#### Accessibility

`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` names the listbox; every option carries
`aria-selected`, including `"false"`. The ✓ is `aria-hidden`;
`aria-selected` is the state. Metadata sits inside the option so it is read
with the label. Text meets 4.5:1; frame and rings 3:1. Rows are at least 24
CSS pixels tall, with the check gutter as the leading target area.

#### Portability

Rows with a background, a glyph gutter and an outline; nothing else. Native
list views take the fill, inactive fill and divider colour and keep their
own keyboard model. The inactive fill applies when the list's window or pane
loses focus; the web detects it with `:focus-within` on the pane.

#### Non-examples

A selected row marked by a border or check without the fill. Rounded row
highlights. Muted metadata left on the selection fill. Every row a tab stop.
Navigating on selection. Disabled rows removed from the arrow-key order.
Hover that changes text colour. A frameless list on the canvas.

### Badge (`badge`)

A small square label for a status or a count; every status carries its glyph and its fill, the outline form uses the status border, and an empty badge is a dot with a name. Family: display. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, empty.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| danger.bg | `color.status.danger.fill` | `#dc282e` | use |
| danger.text | `color.status.danger.on-fill` | `#f9faf9` | use |
| danger.border | `color.status.danger.border` | `#e53935` | use |
| danger.outline-text | `color.status.danger.text` | `#f73f35` | use |
| warning.bg | `color.status.warning.fill` | `#c9973f` | use |
| warning.text | `color.status.warning.on-fill` | `#0c0909` | use |
| warning.border | `color.status.warning.border` | `#c9973f` | use |
| warning.outline-text | `color.status.warning.text` | `#c9973f` | use |
| success.bg | `color.status.success.fill` | `#86a46f` | use |
| success.text | `color.status.success.on-fill` | `#0c0909` | use |
| success.border | `color.status.success.border` | `#86a46f` | use |
| success.outline-text | `color.status.success.text` | `#86a46f` | use |
| info.bg | `color.status.info.fill` | `#7e9ebb` | use |
| info.text | `color.status.info.on-fill` | `#0c0909` | use |
| info.border | `color.status.info.border` | `#7e9ebb` | use |
| info.outline-text | `color.status.info.text` | `#7e9ebb` | use |
| neutral.bg | `color.status.neutral.fill` | `#a3676b` | use |
| neutral.text | `color.status.neutral.on-fill` | `#000000` | use |
| neutral.border | `color.status.neutral.border` | `#a3676b` | use |
| neutral.outline-text | `color.status.neutral.text` | `#bd787d` | use |
| count.bg | `color.action.primary.bg` | `#7d1310` | use |
| count.text | `color.action.primary.text` | `#ffa2a7` | use |

#### Purpose

Names a status or shows a count next to the thing it describes. A badge is
read-only: it never opens, toggles or removes anything. An interactive label
is a chip; a message with a status is an alert.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy. The glyphs are ✕ danger, ! warning, ✓
success, i info and · neutral.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | fill, glyph and text for the status; or the outline form | the glyph; the text |
| empty | an 8px square dot in the status fill; glyph and text visually hidden | `role="img"` with `aria-label`, or the hidden text; the dot's position beside its subject |

No hover, focus, pressed or disabled state: a badge is not a control.

#### Keyboard

None. When a badge summarises something the user can act on, the action lives
in the neighbouring control and the badge is part of that control's name or
description.

#### Accessibility

The text carries the meaning, so a reader hears "Failed", not "cross Failed".
The count's hidden unit reads as "12 unread". An empty badge may wrap hidden
text instead of `aria-label`; a dot with no name is decoration and must be
`aria-hidden`. Text meets 4.5:1; outline borders and dots 3:1 on the panel
surface. Badges are not targets, so no size minimum applies beyond legibility
at 11px caption type.

#### Portability

Toolkits without background colours on labels use the outline form. Hosts
without the glyph characters use the nearest available (x, !, check mark, i,
bullet) and record it.

#### Non-examples

Rounded or pill badges. A clickable badge. A status by colour without its
glyph. A count unit hidden from assistive technology. Purple, cyan or magenta
statuses. A badge in body type. Wrapping text. A dot without a name.

### Chip (`chip`)

A square bordered token for a filter, a removable value or a static tag; a pressed filter chip takes the selection fill and a check glyph. Family: display. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, selected, selected+focus-visible, disabled.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| root.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| root.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| root.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| root.bg-pressed | `color.interaction.pressed.bg` | `#420f0c` | use |
| root.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| root.text-disabled | `color.text.disabled` | `#8a5559` | use |
| root.border-disabled | `color.border.disabled` | `#7d1310` | use |
| root.bg-disabled | `color.interaction.disabled.bg` | `#160b0b` | use |
| selected.bg | `color.interaction.selection.bg` | `#531310` | use |
| selected.text | `color.interaction.selection.text` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| selected.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| remove.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| remove.text-hover | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| remove.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg-strong` | `#630f0d` | use |

#### Purpose

One value the user can toggle or remove: a filter, a multiselect choice, a
record's tag. A chip that only informs is a badge; one that runs an action is
a button.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; a static chip is a span with nothing else.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | 1px {color.border.control} on {color.surface.default}; text {color.text.default} | — |
| hover | background → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; remove button → {color.interaction.hover.bg-strong} with {color.text.bright} | cursor: pointer |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px on the chip or the remove button | the ring |
| selected | fill {color.interaction.selection.bg}; text and glyph {color.interaction.selection.text}; border takes the fill colour | `aria-pressed="true"`; the ✓ glyph |
| selected+focus-visible | the fill and 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px | both visible at once |
| disabled | {color.text.disabled}, {color.border.disabled}, {color.interaction.disabled.bg}; no hover | `disabled`; cursor: not-allowed |

A filter chip shows {color.interaction.pressed.bg} only while pressed.
Precedence: disabled > selected > hover; focus-visible is always drawn.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table. The label of a removable chip is not focusable; inside a
token field the field owns Backspace and the arrow keys.

#### Accessibility

A filter chip keeps the same label in both states; the ✓ is `aria-hidden`.
The remove button's name ("Remove <value>") is unambiguous out of context;
removing a chip moves focus to the next chip or the field. Text meets 4.5:1;
border and rings 3:1. Chips and remove buttons are at least 24×24 CSS pixels
in `compact`, with 4px between neighbours.

#### Portability

A bordered box with a background and an outline; the remove control is an
ordinary small button. Native toggle buttons take the fill for the checked
state. A host without a glyph draws the check as a 2px inset rule at the
inline start and records it.

#### Non-examples

Pill or rounded chips. A selected chip shown by border colour alone, without
the fill and `aria-pressed`. A nameless ×. A chip that is a link. A static tag
that reacts to hover. Disabling by opacity. A label clipped by the border. A
chip in caption type (that is a badge).

### Table (`table`)

A native data table with a header rule, row dividers, hover and selection fills, sortable headers with a glyph, and static empty and loading rows. Family: display. Priority: R1. Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, selected, selected+focus-visible, selected+container-inactive, sorted, empty, loading.

| Part | Role | Value | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| header.text | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| header.bg | `color.surface.default` | `#100c0c` | use |
| header.rule | `color.border.strong` | `#9e231f` | use |
| header.bg-sticky | `color.surface.raised` | `#160b0b` | use |
| sort.glyph | `color.text.bright` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| sort.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| row.text | `color.text.default` | `#e99499` | use |
| row.divider | `color.border.divider` | `#2b0e0d` | use-and-report (D-008) |
| row.bg-hover | `color.interaction.hover.bg` | `#1c0a09` | use |
| selected.bg | `color.interaction.selection.bg` | `#531310` | use |
| selected.text | `color.interaction.selection.text` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| selected.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |

#### Purpose

Records as rows, attributes as columns, compared down a column. For
reading only: selection, resizing and a toolbar make it a `data-table`; a
single column of rows is a `list`.

#### Anatomy

Parts as listed in the anatomy; the sticky header sits on
{color.surface.raised}.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | rows on {color.surface.default}; header rule 1px {color.border.strong} | — |
| hover | row → {color.interaction.hover.bg} | cursor: default; hover-capable pointers only |
| selected | row fill {color.interaction.selection.bg}; every cell {color.interaction.selection.text} | `aria-selected="true"` on the row |
| selected+focus-visible | the fill and 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px around the row | both visible at once |
| selected+container-inactive | row fill {color.interaction.selection.inactive-bg} with {color.interaction.selection.inactive-text}; no ring | lightness drop between the two fills |
| sorted | ▲ (ascending) or ▼ (descending) in {color.text.bright} on the sorted header | `aria-sort`; the glyph |
| empty | one full-width cell in {color.text.muted}: "No rows match." | the message text |
| loading | one full-width cell with the static `⋯` glyph in {color.text.muted}; the header stays | `aria-busy="true"`; the glyph; no animation |

Precedence: loading > empty; selected > hover; focus-visible is always
drawn.

#### Keyboard

As in the key table. Rows that are targets (row links, row selection) make
it a `data-table`, which adds row focus.

#### Accessibility

`caption` or `aria-labelledby` names the table; `scope="row"` on a row
header column. `aria-sort` is `none` or absent on unsorted headers; the
glyph is `aria-hidden`. Empty and loading rows are real rows; a live region
reports the loading outcome. Text meets 4.5:1; rings 3:1. Rows are at least
24 CSS pixels tall; sort buttons fill the header cell.

#### Portability

Row backgrounds, one border under the header, one between rows, an outline
on a selected row. Native table views take the rule, the divider and the two
fills. A host that cannot outline a row draws the ring as an inset 1px
border and records it.

#### Non-examples

Zebra striping. A rounded or bordered frame. A selected row marked by a
left bar (that is navigation). Header text in caption size or uppercase.
Sorting by colour alone without `aria-sort` and a glyph. An animated
spinner. An empty state that removes the header. Truncated text with no way
to read the full value. Hover fill on touch.

Maturity: stable. States: default, hover, focus-visible, selected, selected+focus-visible, sorted, mixed, empty, loading.

| row.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| selected.bg | `color.interaction.selection.bg` | `#531310` | use |
| selected.text | `color.interaction.selection.text` | `#f4eeee` | use |
| selected.ring | `color.interaction.focus.ring` | `#e53935` | use |
| checkbox.bg | `color.surface.input` | `#000000` | use |
| checkbox.border | `color.border.control` | `#a3676b` | use-and-report (D-007) |
| checkbox.checked-bg | `color.action.primary.bg` | `#7d1310` | use |
| checkbox.glyph | `color.action.primary.text` | `#ffa2a7` | use |
| resize.handle | `color.border.default` | `#531310` | use |
| resize.handle-hover | `color.border.active` | `#e53935` | use |
| empty.text | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |
| loading.glyph | `color.text.muted` | `#bd787d` | use |

#### Purpose

A table the user works in; the plain `table` is for reading. It stays a
native table so cells keep their header associations; a host that needs
cell-level navigation promotes it to a grid and records the change.

#### Anatomy

The `table` structure, rule, dividers and fills, plus the parts listed in
the anatomy; row checkboxes have a 1px {color.border.control} boundary.

#### States

| State | Visual | Non-colour channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | rows on {color.surface.default}; header rule 1px {color.border.strong} | — |
| hover | row → {color.interaction.hover.bg}; a resize handle → {color.border.active} | cursor: default on rows, col-resize on handles |
| focus-visible | 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px around the focused row or control | the ring |
| selected | row fill {color.interaction.selection.bg}; every cell {color.interaction.selection.text}; row checkbox checked | `aria-selected="true"`; the checked box |
| selected+focus-visible | the fill and 1px dashed {color.interaction.focus.ring} at −2px | both visible at once |
| sorted | ▲ or ▼ in {color.text.bright} on the sorted header | `aria-sort`; the glyph |
| mixed | select-all on {color.action.primary.bg} with the – glyph | `aria-checked="mixed"`; the glyph |
| empty | one full-width cell in {color.text.muted}: "No rows match."; header and controls stay | the message text |
| loading | one full-width cell with the static `⋯` glyph; the header stays | `aria-busy="true"`; the glyph; no animation |

Precedence: loading > empty; selected > hover; focus-visible is always
drawn. Selection is a fill, focus a ring; neither borrows the other's form.

#### Keyboard

Controls inside the focused row are reached with Tab and left with
Shift+Tab. Column widths come from a header menu or the handle, which is
never a tab stop.

#### Accessibility

Each row checkbox is labelled by the row's first data cell
(`aria-labelledby`); the select-all is named "Select all rows".
`aria-selected` on the row mirrors its checkbox. The selected-row count is
announced through a live region owned by the surrounding toolbar. Text meets
4.5:1; boundaries and rings 3:1. Checkboxes and handles are at least 24 CSS
pixels tall in `compact`.

#### Portability

The `table` drawing plus a checkbox column and header checkbox; the handle
is a 1px rule. Native table views map row selection to their selection model
and mixed to their tristate checkbox. A host without row focus keeps the
checkbox as the only row control and records it.

#### Non-examples

A grid role on a table not navigated cell by cell. Zebra stripes. A
select-all that is a native checkbox with a script-only indeterminate state
and no `aria-checked`.
Row selection by click with no checkbox alternative. A selected row shown by
a border alone. A resize handle as a tab stop. An animated loading skeleton.
Rounded checkboxes. Truncated text with no full-value affordance.
